title: Closing the Gap: Solving the Top 3 Challenges for M&A Sellers
summary: Laca Wong-Hammond of Lument shares M&A insights on the three P’s of transaction marketing and how sellers can maximize value.
body_markdown:
[Laca Wong-Hammond](https://www.lument.com/mergers-acquisitions/laca-wong-hammond/) , Head of Mergers & Acquisitions at Lument, outlines three common seller obstacles in M&A transactions: the valuation gap, continuity of operations, and preservation of legacy.


From earn-outs and staged closings to protecting confidentiality and vetting buyers, Laca shares how sellers can overcome hurdles and get deals done.


###### Buyers and sellers alike can benefit from the options Lument’s M&A team provides.
